facts.text: The first powered, controlled, and sustained flight of a helicopter was made by Igor Sikorsky in 1939
facts.voiceNarration: Did you know? The first helicopter to fly was built by Igor Sikorsky in 1939!
facts.imageDescription: Igor Sikorsky standing next to his helicopter, flying over the ocean, vintage aircraft interior

facts.text: Helicopters can hover in place and fly forwards, backwards, and sideways
facts.voiceNarration: Helicopters have four main rotors that allow them to defy gravity and move in any direction!
facts.imageDescription: Helicopter hovering above a cityscape, aircraft silhouette against the sun

facts.text: The largest helicopter ever built is the Z-36 of the German Air Force during WWII
facts.voiceNarration: Get ready for the biggest chopper ever - the Z-36 was a massive helicopter used by the Germans in WWII!
facts.imageDescription: Z-36 helicopter flying overhead, military aircraft and personnel in the background

facts.text: The first civilian helicopter was introduced in 1947
facts.voiceNarration: Helicopters went commercial in 1947 - now we can fly to our destination with ease!
facts.imageDescription: 1950s-style helicopter landing on a runway, vintage airport interior

facts.text: The fastest helicopter ever recorded was the Bell 407 with a speed of 240 knots
facts.voiceNarration: Meet the fastest civilian helicopter - reaching speeds over 280 km/h!
facts.imageDescription: Bell 407 flying at high speed, aircraft instruments and controls visible

facts.text: Helicopters use rotors to generate lift and propulsion
facts.voiceNarration: Helicopter rotors create the magic that lifts you off the ground - incredible engineering!
facts.imageDescription: Close-up of helicopter rotor blades spinning, detailed aircraft mechanics

facts.text: The first compound helicopter was developed in the 1940s
facts.voiceNarration: Compound helicopters have two rotors - now we can fly faster and more efficiently!
facts.imageDescription: 1940s-style helicopter with a secondary rotor, vintage aircraft cockpit

facts.text: Helicopters are used for medical emergencies and evacuations all over the world
facts.voiceNarration: Helicopters save lives every day - from medical evacuations to disaster relief!
facts.imageDescription: Emergency medical helicopter landing on a rooftop, doctors and patients inside

facts.text: The longest helicopter flight lasted 1,100 hours in the 1970s
facts.voiceNarration: Helicopters can fly for days - an incredible feat of endurance!
facts.imageDescription: Long-distance helicopter flight with a map showing the route, aircraft instruments

facts.text: The first mass-produced helicopter was the Bell H-13 Sioux
facts.voiceNarration: Bell H-13 Sioux revolutionized helicopter manufacturing - now more helicopters than ever!
facts.imageDescription: Bell H-13 Sioux helicopter landing on a runway, modern aircraft factory interior
